events.title: Mother Russia
events.summary: By Lauren Yee Directed by Tatyana-Marie Carlo It’s 1992 in the country formerly known as the Soviet Union, and the Cold War’s gone lukewarm.
events.description: By Lauren Yee Directed by Tatyana-Marie Carlo It’s 1992 in the country formerly known as the Soviet Union, and the Cold War’s gone lukewarm. Gorbachev is out, Yeltsin is in, and the newborn Russian Federation is getting to know the free market and the Filet-o-Fish. Two old friends—once aspiring KGB agents, now struggling to adapt to the new regime—find work spying on an ex-pop star and absolutely nothing goes according to plan. Fast, sharp, and darkly funny, Mother Russia is a new comedy about what happens when the world flips upside down that asks how ordinary people can recalibrate when the rules change overnight.

events.summary: Blending the shimmering colors of flute and harp, flutist Anna Urrey and harpist Kristi Shade present a program that moves across centuries and styles.
events.description: Blending the shimmering colors of flute and harp, flutist Anna Urrey and harpist Kristi Shade present a program that moves across centuries and styles. A versatile soloist and chamber musician, Urrey has appeared at venues including Carnegie Hall, David Geffen Hall, Le Poisson Rouge, and National Sawdust . Together, they create an intimate and richly textured dialogue between two of the most coloristic instruments in the chamber repertoire.

events.title: Cyrano
events.summary: By Jason O’Connell and Brenda Withers Adapted from Cyrano de Bergerac by Edmond Rostand Directed by Meredith McDonough Filled to the brim with pathos and panache, this irreverent adaptation of Rostand’s iconic romance is the Trinity Rep…
events.description: By Jason O’Connell and Brenda Withers Adapted from Cyrano de Bergerac by Edmond Rostand Directed by Meredith McDonough Filled to the brim with pathos and panache, this irreverent adaptation of Rostand’s iconic romance is the Trinity Rep directorial debut of new Artistic Director Meredith McDonough. A hopeless romantic wielding a wit nearly as sharp as his blade, Cyrano quietly pines for the brilliant, beautiful, and kind Roxanne. When she falls for Christian, a handsome soldier, Cyrano’s debilitating insecurities lead him to help his rival by ghostwriting love letters to Roxanne, leading to consequences funny, tragic, and unexpected. By turns mischievous and tender, Cyrano is a delightful celebration of love in all of its forms.

events.title: Another Tequila Sunrise
events.summary: New England-based Eagles tribute, ANOTHER TEQUILA SUNRISE has been performing to sell-out crowds across the country for over twenty years.
events.description: New England-based Eagles tribute, ANOTHER TEQUILA SUNRISE has been performing to sell-out crowds across the country for over twenty years. The standing ovations and thunderous applause emphasize that this group is the premier Eagles Tribute show in the USA. ATS offers a variety of presentation options, including complete album sets, solo material from Don Henley, Joe Walsh, and the late Glenn Frey, and acoustic sets, featuring Eagles classics, many performed as they were originally written. ATS has approached the Eagle’s catalog with reverence, and with painstaking detail, always striving for the most authentic reproduction of the sound and the spirit of the Eagles. Be it their heart-felt ballads (Desperado, Take It To The Limit), country rockers (Lyin’ Eyes, Peaceful Easy Feeling) or guitar-driven stadium anthems (Already Gone, Life In The Fast Lane), Another Tequila Sunrise brings the LIVE Eagles experience to you!

events.title: Greg Abate - A Tribute to Ray Charles
events.summary: Saturday, February 20, 2027 $37 Advance | $40 Day of Show [all-in pricing, no additional fees] Doors 7pm | Show 8pm In the early 1970s, Greg Abate was a working musician in Los Angeles when he auditioned for and won a position with the…
events.description: Saturday, February 20, 2027 $37 Advance | $40 Day of Show [all-in pricing, no additional fees] Doors 7pm | Show 8pm In the early 1970s, Greg Abate was a working musician in Los Angeles when he auditioned for and won a position with the legendary Ray Charles Orchestra in 1973. This new project is a tribute to Ray Charles and features Greg Abate with a stellar group performing music associated with Ray Charles. The group was captured live in concert at WGBH Jazz Boston, in a performance that is currently available on demand through WGBH. A CD of this historic live session is scheduled for release in 2027 on the Summit Records label. For Greg Abate, the recording brings his musical journey with Ray Charles full circle, preserving a live performance that celebrates the legacy of one of America’s greatest musical icons.

events.title: Roomful of Blues
events.summary: Roomful of Blues, the world-renowned, horn-powered, houserocking blues band, has been delighting audiences for over 55 years.
events.description: Roomful of Blues, the world-renowned, horn-powered, houserocking blues band, has been delighting audiences for over 55 years. Blues Music Magazine calls them “the best little big band in the blues.” On record and on stage, Roomful of Blues—led by master guitarist Chris Vachon for the past 25 years—continues to deliver its bone-shaking mix of original songs and carefully chosen covers ranging from jump, swing and proto rock ‘n’ roll to funky, contemporary blues. Their impeccable musicianship and larger-than-life vocals have earned Roomful of Blues five GRAMMY Award nominations and a slew of other accolades, including seven Blues Music Awards. Twice, the prestigious DownBeat International Critics’ Poll has selected them as Best Blues Band. And now, even after 18 previous releases and thousands of live shows, Roomful of Blues continues to evolve. Roomful of Blues, according to DownBeat magazine, “are in a class by themselves.” With their masterful combination of jumping, horn-heavy, hard-edged blues and R&B, it’s no wonder why the great Count Basie called them “the hottest blues band I’ve ever heard.” With a non-stop performance schedule for over 55 years, Roomful of Blues has earned critical, popular and radio success and a legion of fans around the globe. Roomful of Blues guitarist and bandleader Chris Vachon first joined in 1990 and has been leading the band since 1998. Guitar Player says Vachon’s guitar playing “burns with explosive solos and a delightfully greasy sense of rhythm.” The band has maintained its signature sound through great musicianship and a stellar horn section— featuring tenor and alto saxophonist Rich Lataille, who first joined the band in 1970. Lataille’s masterful playing can evoke either the fat-toned, honking sax of the glory days of early rock or the cool elegance of big band swing jazz. Gorbachev is out, Yeltsin is in, and the newborn Russian Federation is getting to know the free market and the Filet-o-Fish. events.description: Feid, global Latin music icon, is bringing FERXXO – THE GREEN STAR TOUR 2027 to arenas across North America. The expansive new arena run brings Feid’s unmistakable energy, magnetic stage presence, and chart-topping catalog to fans across North America for a bold new chapter of the Ferxxo experience. Tickets go on sale November 12 at 10 AM on Ticketmaster.com Spanning 31 dates, FERXXO – THE GREEN STAR TOUR 2027 gives fans a chance to experience Feid live on his biggest stage yet, celebrating the sound, spirit, and captivating energy that have made him one of the most defining artists in Latin music today. Feid is one of the leading global voices in Latin music, redefining modern reggaeton and urban pop for a new generation of listeners worldwide. He has dominated the Billboard charts with a string of hit records, placing seven songs on the Billboard Hot 100 and 25 songs on the Billboard Global 200, in addition to ranking among Spotify’s Top 10 most-streamed artists globally for two consecutive years. Known for a genre-blending sound that fuses reggaeton, pop, and urban influences, the artist, whose moniker sounds like “faith” in Spanish, has collaborated with industry heavyweights including Bad Bunny, J Balvin, Ty Dolla $ign, and DJ Premier. His impact has also been recognized through countless wins and nominations from the Grammys, Latin Grammys, ASCAP Latin Awards, Billboard Music Awards, Billboard Latin Music Awards, iHeartRadio Music Awards, Latin American Music Awards, and more.

events.title: Hans Zimmer Live
events.summary: Multiple Academy Award® and GRAMMY® Award-winning composer Hans Zimmer, together with Semmel Concerts and RCI Global, today announced the North American leg of Hans Zimmer Live - The Next Level, his groundbreaking new live production…
events.description: Multiple Academy Award® and GRAMMY® Award-winning composer Hans Zimmer, together with Semmel Concerts and RCI Global, today announced the North American leg of Hans Zimmer Live - The Next Level, his groundbreaking new live production featuring Zimmer himself on stage alongside his 19-piece band. Following its record-breaking success in Europe, where it ranked among the Top 10 tours worldwide in the first half of 2026, Hans Zimmer Live - The Next Level will arrive in the U.S. and Canada beginning February 17, 2027, and will stop in Boston on February 24 for one show only as part of its ongoing world tour. Tickets go on sale September 25 at 10 AM on Ticketmaster.com A bold evolution of Zimmer's celebrated live concerts, The Next Level combines powerful electronic soundscapes, spectacular lighting design and an entirely new stage production to create a powerful audiovisual spectacle on an unprecedented scale. Fueled by Zimmer's constant desire to push creative boundaries and explore new sonic territory, the show takes audiences on a journey beyond the traditional concert experience. Joining Zimmer on stage is a 19-piece ensemble featuring some of the world's most accomplished musicians and performers. "I want fans to feel like they're at a rave party or riding a roller coaster. For me, every show is a new voyage of discovery," says Zimmer. "The greatest challenge is the status quo - you have to do everything in your power to leave it behind and find and create something new." For decades, Zimmer's unmistakable melodies and groundbreaking compositions have captivated audiences across generations and around the world. His scores have helped define some of the most iconic films in modern cinema, including The Dark Knight trilogy, Inception, Interstellar, Gladiator, Pirates of the Caribbean, The Lion King, Dune: Part One, Dune: Part Two, No Time to Die, Dunkirk, Man of Steel, The Last Samurai, Wonder Woman, Kung Fu Panda, 12 Years a Slave and Top Gun: Maverick.

events.description: Comedian, actor, and impressionist Frank Caliendo’s impeccable comedic timing and spot-on impressions have been the center of fan-favorite viral video clips, TV shows, radio appearances and live shows for more than 20 years. With an enormous collection of impressions at his command, Frank creates extraordinary comedic situations for our culture’s most famous celebrities, sports figures and political leaders. Touring non-stop year-round, Frank’s live shows fill theaters with a high energy blend of observations, impressions, characters and stories for fans of all ages. Frank had a three-year residency at The Monte Carlo Resort and Casino in Las Vegas, performed at the prestigious Radio-Television Correspondents Dinner in Washington D.C., was featured in two Super Bowl Pre-Game shows and an MTV football pregame show with Jimmy Kimmel. Frank was a regular on ESPN’s Sunday NFL Countdown, and makes appearances on SportsCenter and other ESPN shows. He recently starred in the ad campaign for Monday Night Football with Peyton & Eli and his Super Bowl Richard Sherman 30 for 30 mocumentary, and “#IfTrumpWere” parodies have all gone viral. Prior to working with ESPN, Frank spent 10 years on Fox NFL Sunday Pregame. Frank starred in his own TBS TV series, Frank TV, his own hour-long TBS special, Frank Caliendo: All Over The Place, and the half-hour special, Comedy Central Presents: Frank Caliendo. He was a cast member on the Fox TV series MADtv for five years, and he has been a guest over 20 times combined on Jimmy Kimmel Live!, The Tonight Show and The Late Show. -more- As an actor, Frank will be seen in the upcoming film, Daddy Daughter Trip. He was seen in the film, The Comebacks, two episodes of the Disney Channel series, Liv and Maddie, the Bob Odenkirk-produced IFC series, Birthday Boys, the TBS series Sullivan and Son, and an episode of the Valerie Bertinelli and Betty White TV Land series, Hot In Cleveland. Based on Tim Burton’s dearly beloved film, this hilarious musical tells the story of Lydia Deetz, a strange and unusual teenager whose whole life changes when she meets a recently deceased couple and a demon with a thing for stripes. events.description: By Jason O’Connell and Brenda Withers Adapted from Cyrano de Bergerac by Edmond Rostand Directed by Meredith McDonough Filled to the brim with pathos and panache, this irreverent adaptation of Rostand’s iconic romance is the Trinity Rep directorial debut of new Artistic Director Meredith McDonough. A hopeless romantic wielding a wit nearly as sharp as his blade, Cyrano quietly pines for the brilliant, beautiful, and kind Roxanne. When she falls for Christian, a handsome soldier, Cyrano’s debilitating insecurities lead him to help his rival by ghostwriting love letters to Roxanne, leading to consequences funny, tragic, and unexpected. By turns mischievous and tender, Cyrano is a delightful celebration of love in all of its forms.

Tickets go on sale June 5 at 9 AM on Ticketmaster.com Earlier this month, Gracie ushered in a new era with her single “Hit the Wall". Along with the single release, Abrams also shared the official video directed by Renell Medrano. “Hit the Wall” was Gracie’s highest Spotify streaming debut to date and is the lead single from her forthcoming third studio album, Daughter from Hell. Written and produced by Gracie alongside Aaron Dessner, Daughter from Hell will arrive on July 17th. This album comes two years after the release of Gracie’s sophomore album, The Secret of Us which earned Gracie her first ever #1 in the UK, Australia and the Netherlands and debuted at #2 on the Billboard 200. The deluxe album featured seven additional songs including “That’s So True,” which shot up to #6 on the Billboard Hot 100 and marked Gracie’s first entry in the top 10. In 2024, Gracie embarked on The Secret of Us Tour and due to high demand, additional shows in Los Angeles, New York and Denver were added totaling to a three-night run at The Greek Theater in Los Angeles, two nights in Denver and a three-night run at Radio City Music Hall in New York. It was followed by The Secret of Us Deluxe Tour which saw Gracie headlining the largest venues of her career to date, including iconic venues like New York City’s Madison Square Garden, Kia Forum in Los Angeles, and Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Colorado. events.title: Cyrano
events.summary: By Jason O’Connell and Brenda Withers Adapted from Cyrano de Bergerac by Edmond Rostand Directed by Meredith McDonough Filled to the brim with pathos and panache, this irreverent adaptation of Rostand’s iconic romance is the Trinity Rep…
events.description: By Jason O’Connell and Brenda Withers Adapted from Cyrano de Bergerac by Edmond Rostand Directed by Meredith McDonough Filled to the brim with pathos and panache, this irreverent adaptation of Rostand’s iconic romance is the Trinity Rep directorial debut of new Artistic Director Meredith McDonough. A hopeless romantic wielding a wit nearly as sharp as his blade, Cyrano quietly pines for the brilliant, beautiful, and kind Roxanne. When she falls for Christian, a handsome soldier, Cyrano’s debilitating insecurities lead him to help his rival by ghostwriting love letters to Roxanne, leading to consequences funny, tragic, and unexpected. By turns mischievous and tender, Cyrano is a delightful celebration of love in all of its forms.

Now in its 56 th anniversary season, the organization is the largest Latine performing arts institution in the U.S. CARMEN.maquia is a striking reinterpretation of Bizet’s opera through contemporary dance and modernist design. events.summary: CRAIG CONANT is a fast-rising comedian whose laid-back, wildly honest storytelling has made him one of the most in-demand acts on the road today.
events.description: CRAIG CONANT is a fast-rising comedian whose laid-back, wildly honest storytelling has made him one of the most in-demand acts on the road today. He is currently selling out clubs and theaters around the world, building a devoted fanbase drawn to his self-deprecating humor and unpredictable, deeply personal stories. His stand-up clips regularly rack up millions of views each week and have generated over half a billion across social media. His raw and hilarious debut special, “Loophole,” will premiere in January on YouTube and mark a major milestone in a career that shows no signs of slowing down. Craig was named a New Face of Comedy at the Just For Laughs Festival and has performed at Netflix Is A Joke Fest, further cementing his status as a breakout voice in stand-up. His rapid rise has also translated online, where he’s gained over a million followers in the past year alone. A regular at the iconic Comedy Store — where his name is now painted on the wall — Craig continues to expand his reach through his hit COMMUNITY SERVICE PODCAST where he dives headfirst into silly conversations about life, relationships, stand-up comedy, and “that moment” where you faced your fears and found your path to success. For Craig “that moment” was being sentenced to 50 hours of Community Service for an incident involving a police horse. Past guests include Bill Burr, Trevor Wallace, Bobby Lee, Rosebud Baker, Greg Fitzsimmons, Punkie Johnson, Chelcie Lynn, and Ralph Barbosa. Tickets: https://www.ricomedyconnection.com/events/craig-conant-2027

events.title: Greta Van Fleet
events.summary: GRAMMY® Award-winning rock and roll band Greta Van Fleet announces their 2027 North American and European headline tour today.
events.description: GRAMMY® Award-winning rock and roll band Greta Van Fleet announces their 2027 North American and European headline tour today. Promoted by Live Nation, the 59-city Into The Beginning Tour includes a stop at TD Garden on March 5 with special guests The Kooks and Luna Li. Tickets go on sale October 15 at 10 AM on Ticketmaster.com Since 2012, the mission of music has been Greta Van Fleet’s compass and horizon, sending them around the world and back again. They went from playing dive bars and clubs in their native Michigan to arenas and stadiums. They canvassed the globe, lived beyond their own imagination, and returned awake to the world. All of that time, travel, and triumph subconsciously shaped and strengthened the bond between the quartet: the Kiszka brothers Josh [lead vocals], Jake [guitar], and Sam [bass, keys] as well as Daniel Wagner [drums]. That bond remains the engine behind their music and, nine years after their inception, is arguably stronger than ever on the GRAMMY® Award-winning multiplatinum band’s fifth full-length LP, PALACE FOR THE PEOPLE [LAVA/Republic Records]. They’ve made a mysterious, monumental, and cataclysmic body of work, painting a sonic tableau out of powerhouse vocals, earth-rupturing riffs, and stunning solos. This is expressive, ethereal, and energetic rock and roll music delivered with apropos symphonic grace, revelrous excess, dynamics, and the glory of a collective who refuse to be boxed in musically, thematically, or spiritually. It’s also the brilliance of a bloodline committed to tape. They have taken another massive creative leap, building a new place for listeners to congregate and determining the tone for rock’s future in the process. Writing in a remote cabin in Tennessee’s wilderness, they harnessed the inimitable electricity of the familial bond between Josh, Jake, and Sam augmented by their eternal brotherhood with Daniel. He is currently selling out clubs and theaters around the world, building a devoted fanbase drawn to his self-deprecating humor and unpredictable, deeply personal stories. His stand-up clips regularly rack up millions of views each week and have generated over half a billion across social media. His raw and hilarious debut special, “Loophole,” will premiere in January on YouTube and mark a major milestone in a career that shows no signs of slowing down. Craig was named a New Face of Comedy at the Just For Laughs Festival and has performed at Netflix Is A Joke Fest, further cementing his status as a breakout voice in stand-up. His rapid rise has also translated online, where he’s gained over a million followers in the past year alone. A regular at the iconic Comedy Store — where his name is now painted on the wall — Craig continues to expand his reach through his hit COMMUNITY SERVICE PODCAST where he dives headfirst into silly conversations about life, relationships, stand-up comedy, and “that moment” where you faced your fears and found your path to success. For Craig “that moment” was being sentenced to 50 hours of Community Service for an incident involving a police horse. events.description: After performing his smash-hit show ‘Horizons’ to nearly half a million people across the world, PROFESSOR BRIAN COX is back with his new world tour Emergence. Brian has appeared in many landmark science programmes for BBC radio and television over the last 15 years, from the Peabody Award-winning Wonders of the Solar System to the world-wide hit series The Planets . Professor Brian Cox said: “I’ve loved creating Emergence - it’s the most ambitious live show I’ve ever written. I’ve been very lucky to collaborate with a wonderful group of scientists, musicians, filmmakers and graphic artists to bring cosmology, biology, philosophy and history to the largest and most advanced LED screens available, with the best sound and lights I could find. I hope the show is an all-encompassing experience, and I hope it leaves everyone, whether they love science or music or history, or simply contemplating the beauty of Nature, with something new to think about.”

Drums with a Scottish accent. A blazing rock band and show so hot, it carries its own health warning! It’s Bagpipes. It’s Rock. It’s Bagrock. AC/DC meets the poet Robert Burns. Where rock anthems sit comfortably alongside the great tunes from the glens and the mountains of Scotland. It’s The Red Hot Chilli Pipers (not the Peppers)! They are the most famous bagpipe band on the planet – ever! An internationally renowned ensemble consisting of pipers, guitarists, keyboards, and drummers, they have been rocking the world from New York to Beijing to Melbourne and everywhere in between with musicianship of the highest order and a passion for pipes that will leave you breathless. The band has four music degrees from the Royal Scottish Academy of Music and Drama and all the pipers and drummers have played at the top level in bagpiping. Formed in 2002, The Chillis have fast become a global phenomenon, taking their signature ‘Bagrock’ sound to the masses with their unique fusion of rocked up Bagpipes and clever covers of popular songs from all genres. Their trademarked sound is a unique fusion of traditional pipe tunes – like “The Flowers of Scotland”, “The Hills of Argyll”, and “Amazing Grace” (done Chilli-style, of course!) — and contemporary anthems from legendary classic rock groups like Queen, Coldplay, Robbie Williams, AC/DC and many more. A hopeless romantic wielding a wit nearly as sharp as his blade, Cyrano quietly pines for the brilliant, beautiful, and kind Roxanne. By turns mischievous and tender, Cyrano is a delightful celebration of love in all of its forms.

events.title: “The Legacy of the American Revolution: Thomas Wilson Dorr & the Right of Resistance” with historians Erik Chaput & Russell DeSimone
events.summary: Thursday, March 11 th , 2027 6:30pm; Doors open at 5:30pm for a complimentary reception Richard I. Burnham Resource Center Expertly edited by historians Erik J. Chaput and Russell J.
events.description: Thursday, March 11 th , 2027 6:30pm; Doors open at 5:30pm for a complimentary reception Richard I. Burnham Resource Center Expertly edited by historians Erik J. Chaput and Russell J. DeSimone, The Selected Writings of Thomas Wilson Dorr offers a perspective on the dramatic politics connected to the 1842 Dorr Rebellion. Chaput and DeSimone bring to life Thomas Dorr’s political career before and after the rebellion that bears his name. Long-time collaborators on public history projects, they explore the shifting politics of the people’s sovereignty, especially the intersection with slavery and race, as the ideology moved from the margins to the center of public discourse in the 1840s and 1850s. The editors provide a lucid introduction to Dorr’s career and frame the individual selections, which come from a multitude of archival sources, with informative headnotes. Book now!

events.description: “Look on every exit as being an entrance somewhere else…” In this enduring comic masterpiece, two minor (but mighty) characters from Shakespeare’s Hamlet suddenly find themselves at the center of the action and completely out of their depth. Summoned to the Danish court with little explanation but to “glean what afflicts” their friend the prince, Rosencrantz and Guildenstern struggle to make sense of their strange circumstances, including a traveling troupe of dissolute actors, and the unsettling feeling that their fates may already be sealed. Brilliantly absurd and endlessly inventive, Stoppard’s modern classic is a hilarious and philosophical romp through Shakespeare’s world that turns existential dread into theatrical delight.

events.description: Thursday, March 11, 2027 $78 Advance | $83 Day of Show [all-in pricing, no additional fees] Doors 7pm | Show 8pm Formed from the cream of Atlanta’s studio musicians, the Atlanta Rhythm Section (actually hailing from nearby Doraville, Georgia) came together in 1970 after working on a Roy Orbison recording session. Since their formation, Atlanta Rhythm Section (ARS) have put out 15 studio albums of excellent original material, and have consistently put on entertaining live shows to audiences all over the world with their many Top 10 hits. Along with contemporaries Lynyrd Skynyrd and Allman Brothers Band, they carry the mantle of “Southern Rock,” but by performing more musically diverse hits with a softer, pop flavor, they have a sound all their own. Hits include “So Into You,” “Imaginary Lover,” “Champagne Jam,” “Doraville,” “I’m Not Gonna Let It Bother Me Tonight,” “Do It Or Die” and “Spooky”. Don’t miss their return to The Narrows.

events.title: Mother Russia
events.summary: By Lauren Yee Directed by Tatyana-Marie Carlo It’s 1992 in the country formerly known as the Soviet Union, and the Cold War’s gone lukewarm.
events.description: By Lauren Yee Directed by Tatyana-Marie Carlo It’s 1992 in the country formerly known as the Soviet Union, and the Cold War’s gone lukewarm. Gorbachev is out, Yeltsin is in, and the newborn Russian Federation is getting to know the free market and the Filet-o-Fish. Two old friends—once aspiring KGB agents, now struggling to adapt to the new regime—find work spying on an ex-pop star and absolutely nothing goes according to plan. Fast, sharp, and darkly funny, Mother Russia is a new comedy about what happens when the world flips upside down that asks how ordinary people can recalibrate when the rules change overnight.

events.title: Brit Floyd: Animals 50
events.summary: Brit Floyd returns in 2027 with Animals 50, a spectacular new production celebrating the 50th anniversary of one of Pink Floyd’s most powerful and enduring albums.
events.description: Brit Floyd returns in 2027 with Animals 50, a spectacular new production celebrating the 50th anniversary of one of Pink Floyd’s most powerful and enduring albums. Released in 1977 and loosely inspired by George Orwell’s classic novel Animal Farm , Animals transformed its themes of power, inequality and social division into a dark and uncompromising musical masterpiece. Featuring the epic compositions “Dogs,” “Pigs (Three Different Ones)” and “Sheep,” the album remains a firm favorite among Pink Floyd fans worldwide. Animals 50 will bring this landmark album to life in its entirety, accompanied by an ambitious new stage production. The show will also feature many of Pink Floyd’s greatest hits and fan favorites, including “Time,” “Money,” “Shine On You Crazy Diamond,” “Comfortably Numb” and “Another Brick in the Wall, Part 2.” In recent years, Brit Floyd has shared stages across the United States, United Kingdom and Europe with musicians from the touring bands of Pink Floyd and Roger Waters. Special guests have included Pink Floyd bassist and vocalist Guy Pratt, backing vocalists Durga McBroom and Machan Taylor, saxophonist Scott Page, and Roger Waters keyboardist Harry Waters and drummer Graham Broad. In the summer of 2025, Brit Floyd also joined iconic musician and producer Alan Parsons for an acclaimed series of double-bill performances at iconic venues throughout California and Nevada. Widely regarded as the world’s premier Pink Floyd experience, Brit Floyd has performed more than 1,600 concerts around the globe since its launch in 2011. The 2027 production will showcase the band’s extraordinary musicianship alongside immersive visuals, theatrical staging, inflatables, lasers and an award-winning laser - light show. Join Brit Floyd for an unforgettable journey through the music, imagery and provocative ideas of Animals and experience Pink Floyd’s timeless music brought vividly to life on stage.

events.title: Def Leppard and Goo Goo Dolls
events.summary: Global icons and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees Def Leppard have announced the most anticipated tour of 2027, with 4-time GRAMMY-nominated band Goo Goo Dolls and very special guests The Struts.
events.description: Global icons and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees Def Leppard have announced the most anticipated tour of 2027, with 4-time GRAMMY-nominated band Goo Goo Dolls and very special guests The Struts. The 45-date tour includes a stop at TD Garden on March 17. Tickets will go on-sale on October 16th at 10 AM on Ticketmaster.com. For every ticket sold, $1 will be donated to City of Hope, one of the largest and most advanced cancer research and treatment organizations in the United States, helping advance groundbreaking research and innovative treatments for people facing cancer. Earlier this year, Def Leppard completed their third sold-out residency in Las Vegas at Caesar’s Palace. The remainder of 2026 has seen them perform sold-out shows across the UK, Europe, South America and Mexico. Also this summer, Def Leppard’s Greatest Hits compilation entered four U.K. Top Charts, two of which debuted in the Top 10 – adding another accolade to the band’s whopping 11 million monthly Spotify listeners and 110+ million albums sold worldwide. The announcement follows the Goo Goo Dolls’ extensive run of Summer Tour dates, which included lauded performances at iHeartRadio Festival and Sea.Hear.Now Festival. Following their viral success, the band’s Diamond-certified (10,000,000 in sales) hit “Iris” has garnered over 6 billion global streams, amassing over 1 billion streams in 2025 alone. Beyond selling 15 million records worldwide, Goo Goo Dolls have garnered 4x GRAMMY-nominations and nearly a dozen platinum and gold singles combined and seized a page in the history books by achieving 15 #1 and Top 10 hits. As a result, they hold the all-time radio record for “Most Top 10 Singles.” Known for their high-energy performances, rock fans can expect a thrilling ride on this upcoming tour from some of rock ‘n’ roll’s most influential bands.

Gorbachev is out, Yeltsin is in, and the newborn Russian Federation is getting to know the free market and the Filet-o-Fish. Two old friends—once aspiring KGB agents, now struggling to adapt to the new regime—find work spying on an ex-pop star and absolutely nothing goes according to plan. events.title: Paula Poundstone
events.summary: From the #1 rated NPR show, "Wait Wait...Don't Tell Me!"
events.description: Iconic comedian Paula Poundstone is known for her smart, observational humor and a spontaneous wit that has become the stuff of legend. She regularly plays theaters across the country, hosts a weekly comedy podcast, Nobody Listens to Paula Poundstone, and is a regular panelist on NPR’s Wait, Wait… Don’t Tell Me. She also voiced the character ‘Forgetter Paula’ in the feature films Inside Out and Inside Out 2. Paula has starred in several HBO specials, including Cats, Cops and Stuff, which nabbed a cable ACE award for Best Comedy Special. She was the first female comic to host the White House Correspondents Dinner. She filed live coverage of the 1992 Democratic and Republican National Conventions and the Presidential Inaugural for The Tonight Show with Jay Leno and at the 93rd Emmy Awards. Paula has starred in two television series, both entitled The Paula Poundstone Show. Paula’s second book, The Totally Unscientific Study of the Search for Human Happiness, was one of eight semi-finalists for the Thurber Prize For American Humor; the audiobook was one of five finalists for the AUDIE award for Audiobook of the Year. Paula has released five albums and is featured in several documentaries and compendiums noting influential comedians of our time.

events.title: Rob Davis Plays Springsteen
events.summary: Performing "The Odeon at the Odeum"
events.description: Rob Davis has made a career making a name for himself as a fixture of the Rhode Island music scene, as a guitarist, vocalist, solo-performer, sideman, and especially as a bandleader. Performing professionally since his teen years, Rob Davis has entertained tens of thousands across Rhode Island and Southern New England throughout his decade-plus music career. A summertime fixture on Block Island, Rob performs a wide-array of music, from country classics to modern day hits. A singer-songwriter in his own right, Rob has released multiple original efforts under his own name, including his 2024 Debut EP “August”. New Jersey runs deep in Rob’s blood. A Jersey native, Rob’s father introduced him to Bruce Springsteen’s music, beginning with “Greetings from Asbury Park, N.J.” up through modern day. Rob cut his teeth on guitar learning Bruce’s music. “Rob Davis plays Springsteen” was hatched not out of necessity, but out of obsession. Flanked by brother Mike Davis, childhood friend Jay Taylor, and a cast of local legends, including Mark Grimm, Richard Ribb, Nate Cronin, Jake Brunelle, and Nick Fede; they present the music as a true band, not a cast of imitators. At every performance, “Rob Davis plays Springsteen” performs a career-spanning set of The Boss’ music, satisfying for the die-hard and casual fan alike. On March 20, Rob and the band will present an authentic re-creation of the legendary “Hammersmith Odeon, London ‘75” Bruce Springsteen & The E Street Band performance, performing that “Born to Run”-era show in its entirety. That portion will be followed by an entire second set of Bruce’s biggest hits and deepest fan favorites. It will surely be a night you won’t soon forget.

events.description: By August Wilson Director to be announced. Blues legend Ma Rainey and her band are getting ready to record new takes of old tracks in a worn-down Chicago studio. When the young, ambitious trumpet player Levee pushes for a different direction, competing visions quickly emerge. As he fights to make a name for himself, Ma Rainey asserts control over her music, while producers press for profit at every turn. Pulitzer Prize-winning playwright August Wilson delivers a blistering exploration of power, racism, and autonomy in this iconic play that’s as melodic as it is profound.

events.title: Cyrano
events.summary: By Jason O’Connell and Brenda Withers Adapted from Cyrano de Bergerac by Edmond Rostand Directed by Meredith McDonough Filled to the brim with pathos and panache, this irreverent adaptation of Rostand’s iconic romance is the Trinity Rep…
events.description: By Jason O’Connell and Brenda Withers Adapted from Cyrano de Bergerac by Edmond Rostand Directed by Meredith McDonough Filled to the brim with pathos and panache, this irreverent adaptation of Rostand’s iconic romance is the Trinity Rep directorial debut of new Artistic Director Meredith McDonough. A hopeless romantic wielding a wit nearly as sharp as his blade, Cyrano quietly pines for the brilliant, beautiful, and kind Roxanne. When she falls for Christian, a handsome soldier, Cyrano’s debilitating insecurities lead him to help his rival by ghostwriting love letters to Roxanne, leading to consequences funny, tragic, and unexpected. By turns mischievous and tender, Cyrano is a delightful celebration of love in all of its forms.

events.title: Denny Love
events.summary: Introducing Denny Love, a Los Angeles–based actor and comedian whose career seamlessly bridges prestige television, live comedy, and viral digital culture.
events.description: Introducing Denny Love, a Los Angeles–based actor and comedian whose career seamlessly bridges prestige television, live comedy, and viral digital culture. A celebrated alumnus of DePaul University’s renowned Theatre School, Denny first broke through with a standout performance in Hulu’s Looking for Alaska, a critically acclaimed series boasting a 92% Rotten Tomatoes rating. He went on to appear in two seasons of Taylor Sheridan’s hit Paramount+ drama Mayor of Kingstown, further solidifying his dramatic range. Beyond the screen, Denny is a commanding live performer who has shared stages with comedy heavyweights like Chris D’Elia and delivered memorable sets opening for Theo Von. As a key cast member of @KevinLangue’s viral YouTube and TikTok content, he has helped build a digital powerhouse of over 4.47 million subscribers and more than 2 billion views worldwide. Denny Love’s live stand up presence is rapidly becoming one of the most exciting forces in comedy. He’s been taking the comedy scene by storm by performing at the most coveted venues in and around the LA area, across the country and internationally. Most notably; The Laugh Factory, The Comedy Store, Improv, Haha Comedy Club, Comedy Chateau, Jam in the Van, Don’t Tell Comedy, Can’t Even, and many more. He recently headlined at the Tokyo Comedy Bar in Tokyo, Japan and ROR Comedy Club in Osaka, Japan. Denny was seen on stages all across America and Canada while on tour with Chris D’elia and most recently in Las Vegas with Theo Von. In 2026, he takes the stage at Netflix Is a Joke, solidifying his place among the most sought-after rising voices in entertainment. This summer, he joins the Kevin Langue Show as a key performer on an ambitious 18- city national theatre tour, bringing his sharp timing and undeniable charisma to audiences across the country. Building on that momentum, Denny will launch his first headlining tour in Fall 2026, marking a major milestone as he steps fully into his own spotlight. Tickets:

events.title: All Things Equal
events.summary: Written by Tony Award Winning playwright RUPERT HOLMES Starring Michelle Azar as Ruth Bader Ginsburg Directed by Laley Lippard Supreme Court Justice “RBG” welcomes a friend of the family to her cozy chambers to convey, over the course of…
events.description: Written by Tony Award Winning playwright RUPERT HOLMES Starring Michelle Azar as Ruth Bader Ginsburg Directed by Laley Lippard Supreme Court Justice “RBG” welcomes a friend of the family to her cozy chambers to convey, over the course of ninety fascinating and often funny minutes, a sense of her life and its many trials: losing her mother the day before she graduated as valedictorian of her Brooklyn high school ... being one of only nine young women studying law at Harvard while also raising a daughter and helping her husband battle cancer ... fighting for women's rights in the nineteen-seventies before condescending all-male courts ... and taking courageous stands for human rights as a voice of reason amid a splintering and increasingly politicized Supreme Court. An evening with a great and compassionate icon of straight-thinking American justice emerges ... an RBG who is not only “notorious” but victorious as she takes a stand for ordinary people facing the many challenges of a changing world. Bring your scrunchies, your hankies, your humor and your heart to this entertaining and uplifting event!

Now, The Outlaws return to the Narrows Center to bring you the best Southern Rock show you can see anywhere. The three guitar army will play their third studio album Hurry Sundown in its entirety along with the hits, fan favorites and deep cuts. Expect to hear “There Goes Another Love Song,” “Hurry Sundown,” “(Ghost) Riders in the Sky,” “Green Grass & High Tides” and many more. Known as The Florida Guitar Army by their fans, The Outlaws earned a formidable reputation as an incendiary live act touring alongside bands such as The Allman Brothers, Lynyrd Skynyrd, The Marshall Tucker Band as well as The Doobie Brothers, The Who, The Eagles and The Rolling Stones. events.title: Jason Carter Band
events.summary: Thursday, April 1, 2027 $37 Advance | $40 Day of Show [all-in pricing, no additional fees] Doors 7pm | Show 8pm In Lloyd, Kentucky, on U.S. 23, there’s a sign on the Country Music Highway dedicated to renowned fiddler Jason Carter .
events.description: Thursday, April 1, 2027 $37 Advance | $40 Day of Show [all-in pricing, no additional fees] Doors 7pm | Show 8pm In Lloyd, Kentucky, on U.S. 23, there’s a sign on the Country Music Highway dedicated to renowned fiddler Jason Carter . It was placed there because of his other accomplishments—the Grammy awards, the worldwide tours, and the many other accolades he’s earned through his music. But for Carter, joining the legendary names honored on that stretch of highway just might mean the most. "There's a certain sound that's up there that you just don't hear anywhere else," he says. "I think that played a big part in how I sound today." True to those Kentucky roots, Carter continues to pour all he has back into bluegrass. For thirty years, he has been the fiddle player for the Del McCoury Band—the most awarded group in bluegrass history. He’s won three Grammy awards, including 2018’s “Best Bluegrass Album” with the Travelin’ McCourys, of which he is a founding member. And he’s taken home five IBMAs for “Fiddle Player of the Year,” a staggering number that isn’t quite so crazy once you realize just how many bluegrass greats have turned to Carter for collaboration.

events.description: Donna The Buffalo is not just a band, rather one might say that Donna The Buffalo has become a lifestyle for its members and audiences. Since 1989, the roots rockers have played thousands of shows and countless festivals including Bonnaroo, Newport Folk Festival, Telluride, Austin City Limits Festival, Merle Fest, and Philadelphia Folk Festival. They’ve opened for The Dead and have toured with Peter Rowan, Del McCoury, Los Lobos, Little Feat, Jim Lauderdale, Rusted Root, and Railroad Earth to name a few. They also toured with Ben & Jerry’s co founder Ben Cohen to help raise awareness about increased corporate spending in politics. In 1991, the band started the Finger Lakes Grassroots Festival in Trumansburg, NY. The four day festival has become an annual destination for over 15,000 music lovers every year and was started as an AIDS benefit. It continues as a benefit for arts and education. To date, the event has raised hundreds of thousands of dollars and is now one of three Grassroots Festivals; the Bi-annual Shakori Hills fest in North Carolina and Virginia Key festival in Florida. events.description: Tuesday, April 6, 2027 $79 Advance | $84 Day of Show [all-in pricing, no additional fees] Doors 7pm | Show 8pm Country songwriter Phil Vassar makes his Narrows Center debut with a full band performance celebrating the 25th anniversary of “Just Another Day In Paradise.” Known for his high-energy shows and piano-driven performances, he’s toured worldwide, performed for U.S. presidents, and shared the stage with legends like Merle Haggard and Willie Nelson — all while building a deep connection with fans who continue to sing along to his timeless catalog. Vassar grew up surrounded by music, from his father’s singing to his sisters’ Motown and West Coast harmonies, with Lynchburg’s gospel and bluegrass shaping his early sound. Influences like Bruce Hornsby, Billy Joel, Elton John, Lionel Richie, and rock icons such as Queen and Boston helped form his eclectic style. Though he began on guitar, he found his true voice at the piano, developing a signature blend of heartfelt storytelling and melodic hooks that crossed genres.

events.title: Roger McGuinn
events.summary: An Evening with ROGER MCGUINN begins with the stage dark and the sound of Roger’s 12-string Rickenbacker guitar filling the house as he approaches the standing microphone to sing his signature Bob Dylan song “My Back Pages.” He always…
events.description: An Evening with ROGER MCGUINN begins with the stage dark and the sound of Roger’s 12-string Rickenbacker guitar filling the house as he approaches the standing microphone to sing his signature Bob Dylan song “My Back Pages.” He always begins his concerts with this song because he takes the audience on the journey through which his love of folk music took him to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. Jim McGuinn (he changed his name later to Roger) began playing guitar when he was 14 and left Chicago for his first professional job at 17. The Limeliters sent him an airplane ticket to Los Angeles to play guitar and banjo on their RCA album “Tonight in Person.” It was during that recording time that he joined them at the Hollywood Bowl opening up for Eartha Kit.” Chad Mitchell heard about McGuinn’s abilities and asked him to join his group, “The Chad Mitchell Trio” as the accompanist on guitar and banjo. He was 18 years old. He toured with the CMT for a year or so but when Bobby Darin saw him performing, he immediately offered McGuinn a job paying twice what he was making with Mitchell. Mr. Darin asked Jim to play his guitar and sing a 15 minute set of folk songs in the middle of his variety concert.

events.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day Live in Concert
events.summary: Terminator 2: Judgment Day Live in Concert celebrates James Cameron’s 1991 ground-breaking sequel to his original 1984 sci-fi classic.
events.description: Terminator 2: Judgment Day Live in Concert celebrates James Cameron’s 1991 ground-breaking sequel to his original 1984 sci-fi classic. Experience Brad Fiedel’s powerful, industrial soundscape performed by a live 8-musician ensemble in-sync with the film that redefined the action genre. Building on his iconic themes from The Terminator, Fiedel expands the score into a sweeping, emotional journey, combining metallic percussion, pulsing synthesizers, and haunting melodic textures. The result is a sound world that perfectly captures the film’s fusion of human emotion and machine precision. A triumph of storytelling, visual effects, and music, Terminator 2: Judgment Day reunites Arnold Schwarzenegger as the Terminator, now reprogrammed to protect young John Connor (Edward Furlong) from a relentless new enemy, the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick). Together with John’s mother, Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton), they fight to prevent Judgment Day and the rise of the machines. An evolution of sound and spectacle, Terminator 2: Judgment Day Live in Concert brings Brad Fiedel’s unforgettable score to life in real time – an electrifying, immersive experience that amplifies every moment in one of cinema’s greatest sequels. Terminator 2 is rated R. Film in English with English captions.

events.title: Niall Horan
events.summary: The North American dates for Niall Horan Dinner Party Live On Tour have been announced. The chart-topping global superstar will perform at arenas across North America in support of his new album, Dinner Party, which will be released on…
events.description: The North American dates for Niall Horan Dinner Party Live On Tour have been announced. The chart-topping global superstar will perform at arenas across North America in support of his new album, Dinner Party, which will be released on June 5, 2026. There’s something about sharing a table that feels like sharing a future and Dinner Party brings the listener into that experience with warmth, wit and sincerity. The album is cinematic and organic, with songs that play like memories being gently created. Julian Bunetta and John Ryan, Horan’s longtime collaborators, served as executive producers. His other creative partners and co-writers included Afterhrs, Amy Allen, Ian Franzino, Andrew Haas, Steph Jones, Rocky Block and Joel Little. The multi-Platinum-selling singer/songwriter first rose to prominence as part of the internationally acclaimed One Direction and has since firmly established himself as a powerhouse solo artist, selling over 90 million records worldwide. He launched his solo career with the Platinum-certified album Flicker, which featured the triple-Platinum hit “Slow Hands.” Horan has since released three additional albums —Heartbreak Weather, which ranked No. 1 on both Billboard’s Top Album Sales Chart and the U.K.’s Official Albums Chart, The Show, which topped the same two charts, and The Show: Encore. His 2024 global headline trek “THE SHOW” LIVE ON TOUR brought his music to packed arenas across multiple continents, culminating in a sold-out North American run and over 1.2 million tickets sold worldwide.

events.description: Jeffrey Keller brings his stand-up comedy to Comedy Connection in East Providence, Rhode Island, on April 16–17. The New York City comedian combines sharp wit, boyish charm and a background in musical theatre for a show full of personality. Drawing inspiration from everyday life and his theatrical roots, Keller blends storytelling with impeccable timing and a distinctly hammy edge. His background in musical theatre adds an expressive flair to his stand-up, while his personal experiences provide the material for his unique sense of humor. As a straight man with an eclectic circle of mainly gay theatre friends, Keller offers a perspective shaped by the people and personalities around him. Add a mullet, a punchable face and a big smile, and you have the full Jeffrey Keller package—delivered with the infectious energy that wins over audiences. Catch Jeffrey Keller live at Comedy Connection on April 16–17. Whether you’re familiar with his comedy or discovering him for the first time, join us for live stand-up in the Providence area. events.description: Recently featured in Essence Magazine, Orchestra Noir is bringing its all-new Culture 2000 Tour II to New Haven. Experience the biggest Hip-Hop and R&B hits of the 2000s reimagined with the power of a live orchestra. From club anthems and radio favorites to unforgettable slow jams and Southern classics, this brand-new production delivers a night of nostalgia, energy, and incredible live music. Through orchestral performance, Orchestra Noir celebrates the cultural achievements of African-American music pioneers across all genres of music including classical, jazz, blues, hip-hop, and R&B. Orchestra Noir has witnessed a meteoric rise to become one of the most talked about orchestras in the nation, continuing to bring orchestral music to diverse audiences in grand and spectacular fashion. ​

events.title: Greg Hawkes with Eddie Japan Performing the Music of The Cars
events.summary: Saturday, April 17, 2027 $52 Advance | $55 Day of show [all-in pricing, no additional fees] Doors 7pm | Show 8pm Greg Hawkes of The Cars brings the music of The Cars to the stage, backed by acclaimed Boston-based band Eddie Japan for a…
events.description: Saturday, April 17, 2027 $52 Advance | $55 Day of show [all-in pricing, no additional fees] Doors 7pm | Show 8pm Greg Hawkes of The Cars brings the music of The Cars to the stage, backed by acclaimed Boston-based band Eddie Japan for a full-band celebration of one of rock’s most distinctive and enduring catalogs. As the keyboardist for the legendary Boston band and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees The Cars, Greg Hawkes helped forge one of the defining sounds of rock’s New Wave era. Pioneering and pushing the limits of technology and sequencing in the late ’70s and throughout the ’80s, Greg helped cement the synthesizer’s place in rock and pop music, influencing countless artists who followed. Along with achieving Rock & Roll Hall of Fame status and massive commercial success with The Cars, Greg has been a sought-after session and touring musician, working with artists including Paul McCartney, Todd Rundgren and The Turtles.

events.title: Laurie Berkner
events.summary: Laurie Berkner has been a professional musician since 1992, but her success as a children’s recording artist was a surprise to her. “It was so unexpected,” says Laurie.
events.description: Laurie Berkner has been a professional musician since 1992, but her success as a children’s recording artist was a surprise to her. “It was so unexpected,” says Laurie. “I’d been performing in rock bands and struggling to write original music. Writing music for kids has not been a struggle at all. The more I started working on material for children, the more I realized that it opened up creativity in me that I never knew I had.” These days critics widely acknowledge Laurie’s major contribution toward launching what is now dubbed the progressive “kindie rock” movement – i.e. less saccharine, more rocking music that is not dumbed down for children. But it wasn’t simply an enormous amount of talent that helped create an entire genre and skyrocketed Laurie to her current position as “the queen of kids’ music” (People magazine). It was an ability to gain parents’ enthusiasm for the songs as well. According to Laurie, “When I’m writing a song, I’m thinking about whether the kids will like it and whether I’m going to connect to them through it. I’m also thinking about whether I want to sing it over and over again, so I guess that’s the part that connects with adults. ‘Old MacDonald Had a Farm’ is a great song for kids, but I couldn’t sing it 100 times!” While Laurie never planned to be a children’s performer, looking back on her career it almost seems inevitable. While growing up in Princeton, New Jersey, Laurie was always involved in music, whether singing in choirs, playing in bands, or performing in musical theater. In high school and throughout college (at Rutgers University), she toured Europe with several choirs and orchestras as a soloist and guitarist. After graduation, Laurie spent ten years as a children’s music specialist at New York City area preschool and day care centers. events.description: April 18th 2027, 1:00 pm Film runtime: 1 hour 33 minutes including intermission With Clark Wilson on the Mighty Wurlitzer Organ This 1922 swashbuckling classic is widely regarded for its massive scale, groundbreaking production design and Douglas Fairbanks’ athletic, charming performance as the Earl of Huntingdon (later Robin Hood) as he works to overthrow the tyrannical Prince John while King Richard is off fighting in the Crusades. About Clark Wilson Winner of “The Theatre Organist of the Year Award” in 1998, Clark Wilson has been an organist and conservator for the last thirty years. With a multitude of performances, in addition to having seven albums under his belt, Clark Wilson shares his passion with students as an organ faculty member at the University of Oklahoma, teaching silent film scoring, organ lessons as well as the history of the American theater organ. A talented musician and live performer, Clark’s magical sounds have led to yearly presentations at the Los Angeles Philharmonic Society at the Walt Disney Concert Hall organ. events.title: Michael Palascak
events.summary: Last year Michael Palascak appeared on Nateland Presents: The Showcase on YouTube. Michael also released his self-produced special He's Friendly which has garnered over 215, 000 views on YouTube and has multiple tracks streaming on Sirius…
events.description: Last year Michael Palascak appeared on Nateland Presents: The Showcase on YouTube. Michael also released his self-produced special He's Friendly which has garnered over 215, 000 views on YouTube and has multiple tracks streaming on Sirius XM’s comedy channels like Pure Comedy. You can also find him on Paramount + where his debut half hour is streaming on Season 1, Episode 2 of Comedy Central’s The Half Hour and on an episode in the new season of Comics Unleashed. Michael grew up in a small town in Indiana and began doing stand-up in Chicago after his parents moved the family to the suburbs during his formative years. Drew Hunt of The Chicago Reader writes about Michael’s stand-up, “In a lot of ways, he represents the ideal antidote to the sort of unbridled cynicism that pervades much of contemporary stand-up.” The Guardian writes, “In stand up, there is the writing, and then there is the performing. This guy nails both… clean, clever, dark and, most importantly, funny.” Michael also has racked up multiple late night credits with appearances on The Tonight Show, The Late Show, The Late Late Show, and Conan. Additionally, he was a Top 5 Finalist on the last season of Last Comic Standing after eliminating Taylor Tomlinson in a head-to-head stand-up competition where one judge claimed, “My first impression of Michael was a great likability. This is a guy that could star in a sitcom.” Michael currently resides in California and is a dad. Every Monday night he records a podcast after his kid goes to sleep. It is called I Just Got My Kid To Sleep. Tickets: https://www.ricomedyconnection.com/events/michael-palascak-2026

events.summary: The Neighbourhood announces The Wourld Tour II. The announcement of these additional shows comes as the band head into the remaining dates of their current global, sold-out The Wourld Tour.
events.description: The Neighbourhood announces The Wourld Tour II. The announcement of these additional shows comes as the band head into the remaining dates of their current global, sold-out The Wourld Tour. Tickets go on sale October 30 at 10 AM on Ticketmaster.com With their latest album (((((ultraSOUND))))) and sold-out global The Wourld Tour, The Neighbourhood have reached a remarkable chapter in their career. Along the way they’ve built a loyal fanbase who show up in force and bring an electric energy to every show. In a recent cover feature on The Neighbourhood, Pollstar noted “they returned to the industry...wiser, refreshed and more beloved than they could ever imagine.” The Neighbourhood is California-based alternative rock band comprised of members Jesse Rutherford, Zach Abels, Brandon Fried, Jeremy Freeman, and Mikey Margott. Known for their genre-blending sound and moody aesthetic, the band formed in 2011 and broke through in 2013 with their double-Platinum debut album I Love You. The album features the multi-platinum hit "Sweater Weather," which reached No. 1 on Billboard’s Alternative chart. Following the success of their sophomore album Wiped Out! (2015) and a string of EPs, the group continued evolving their sound with The Neighbourhood (2018) and Chip Chrome & the Mono-Tones (2020). With five multi-Platinum, six Platinum, and eight Gold certified singles along with two additional Platinum albums, The Neighbourhood has built a legacy of genre-defining work and is poised to begin a compelling new chapter. Their latest album (((((ultraSOUND))))), was released on Warner Records after a 5-year hiatus and met with excitement from fans across the globe. The album’s single “Private” is climbing Alternative Radio charts and the album has amassed 393 million global streams.

events.title: Sonia Flew
events.summary: “And I said, I do not forgive you, I will never forgive you. You have broken my heart.” Sonia has built a comfortable life in Minnesota—devoted husband, loving children, and a carefully guarded past.
events.description: “And I said, I do not forgive you, I will never forgive you. You have broken my heart.” Sonia has built a comfortable life in Minnesota—devoted husband, loving children, and a carefully guarded past. But when her son decides to enlist in the military immediately post 9/11, memories she has long buried begin to resurface. As a teenager, Sonia was forced to flee Cuba during the revolution, leaving behind the family she adored. Spanning 40 years, the story traces one family’s journey through exile, loss, and reconciliation. Both sweeping and intimate, Sonia Flew examines the steep price of freedom and the complicated meaning of home.

events.summary: For more than six decades, Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater has captivated audiences around the world with performances that blend breathtaking athleticism, expressive storytelling, and the rich traditions of modern dance.
events.description: For more than six decades, Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater has captivated audiences around the world with performances that blend breathtaking athleticism, expressive storytelling, and the rich traditions of modern dance. Founded in 1958, the company has become a cultural touchstone, celebrating the depth, resilience, and beauty of the human spirit while honoring the rich heritage that continues to shape its artistic vision. In these uplifting performances, presented by Vivo Performing Arts at the Boch Center Wang Theatre, extraordinary dancers radiate passion, precision, and joy from the stage. Join us for performances that continue a beloved dance tradition, one that invites audiences to feel deeply, rejoice together, and share in the exhilaration of live performance. “Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater remains one of the most thrilling and deeply moving companies on the planet.” The New York Times

events.title: Candice Guardino's Italian Bred
events.summary: Sold-out theatrical comedy, one show only.
events.description: Candice Guardino’s Italian Bred is a ★★★★★ “MUST SEE!” —praised by critics from New York to Chicago and Los Angeles. After selling out theatres across the country, Candice brings this smash-hit comedy to Rhode Island for one show only! Italian Bred is a hilarious and heartwarming theatrical comedy based on true life events—told through the eyes of a girl growing up Italian on Staten Island. Candice brings her family to life on stage, slipping seamlessly in and out of multiple characters inspired by her outspoken grandmother and unforgettable relatives. Through side-splitting stories, charming songs, and vivid storytelling, she delivers a fresh, irresistible take on the classic solo show. This crowd-pleasing hit will leave audiences laughing, reminiscing, and celebrating their own one-of-a-kind childhoods.

events.description: NICK CAVE has been performing, writing and recording music for more than forty years. He is best known as the lead singer and songwriter of Nick Cave and The Bad Seeds. His body of work extends across a diverse range of creative disciplines - score composition, writing of books, novels and film scripts, and more recently ceramic art. His website and weekly e-mail,The Red Hand Files, originally created for Cave to answer questions submitted by fans, has grown from a simple exercise in connectivity to a cultural phenomenon, now with over 250,000 subscribers, and hundreds of questions submitted each week.

events.description: Scott Freiman , host of the Public Television series Deconstructing the Beatles, returns for another live Deconstructing the Music at the Shubert Theatre. Stay tuned for the announcement of the show's topic! Scott Freiman is a composer, a musician, and a software entrepreneur. He is the creator of Deconstructing The Music, a series of multimedia presentations about the composition and production techniques of The Beatles and other musicians. Scott has presented his lectures to sold out audiences throughout North America at theaters, museums and corporations, such as Pixar, Google, and Facebook. Please note: your ticket purchase includes one alcoholic or non-alcoholic beverage.

events.title: Valery Meladze
events.summary: After the sold-out anniversary world tour, one of the most beloved voices of our time – VALERY MELADZE – returns to the US in 2027.
events.description: After the sold-out anniversary world tour, one of the most beloved voices of our time – VALERY MELADZE – returns to the US in 2027. On May 6, 2027, Boston will experience an unforgettable evening as Valery Meladze takes the Shubert Theatre stage. Audiences can expect deep emotions, meaningful lyrics, and iconic melodies – featuring the timeless hits loved by millions. Above all, it’s the exceptional atmosphere that makes every concert truly special – once you’ve experienced it, you can’t stop talking about it. Valery Meladze’s music bridges generations, and his songs are recognized from the very first note. Each performance is deeply personal and emotionally charged, as he gives his all on stage – delivering passion, energy, and an unforgettable connection with every audience. Boston, Boch Center Shubert Theatre, May 6, 2027 – save the date for the incredible memories! The show will be performed in Russian language.

events.title: Radu Ratoi & Alexandra Tirsu perform Vivaldi, Piazzolla, and more
events.summary: From Bach and Stravinsky to Bartók, Vivaldi, and Piazzolla, accordionist Radu Ratoi and violinist Alexandra Tirsu bring together music shaped by dance, folklore, and virtuosity.
events.description: From Bach and Stravinsky to Bartók, Vivaldi, and Piazzolla, accordionist Radu Ratoi and violinist Alexandra Tirsu bring together music shaped by dance, folklore, and virtuosity. As winner of the 2024 Young Concert Artists “Susan Wadsworth” International Auditions, Ratoi established himself as a pioneer in expanding the accordion’s repertoire. He is joined by internationally acclaimed violinist Alexandra Tirsu, a prizewinner of the 2021 ARD Competition who performs on the 1717 “Reifenberg” Stradivari.

events.summary: Friday, May 7, 2027 $65.00 Advance | $67.00 Day of Show [all-in pricing, no additional fees] Doors 7pm | Show 8pm Since scoring a worldwide smash with her debut album Eye To The Telescope in 2004, which went on to sell over 5 million…
events.description: Friday, May 7, 2027 $65.00 Advance | $67.00 Day of Show [all-in pricing, no additional fees] Doors 7pm | Show 8pm Since scoring a worldwide smash with her debut album Eye To The Telescope in 2004, which went on to sell over 5 million copies, and just celebrated its 20th anniversary, KT Tunstall has remained at the forefront of UK singer- songwriter talent. Tunstall outsold every other female artist in the UK in 2005, won the 2006 Brit Award for Best British Female Solo Artist, an Ivor Novello Best Song award for her huge, self-penned hit ‘Suddenly I See’, and a Q award for Track of the Year. She also landed a Grammy nomination for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance and lent her tunes to a host of movies and TV shows (‘Suddenly I See’, used in the iconic opening scene of Meryl Streep flick ‘The Devil Wears Prada’).

events.title: Josh Johnson's Comedy Band Camp
events.summary: With over 10 million followers across social media, Josh Johnson was recently called “the funniest guy on the internet” by WIRED.
events.description: With over 10 million followers across social media, Josh Johnson was recently called “the funniest guy on the internet” by WIRED. He is an Emmy-nominated writer, stand-up comedian, actor, and NAACP award-winner from Louisiana by way of Chicago. Johnson is currently a rotating host and correspondent on Comedy Central’s Emmy & Peabody Award-winning program The Daily Show. He is also a prolific writer and performer who puts out weekly stand up sets on his YouTube channel. In 2025, Johnson released 38 hours of topical stand up material that was performed in front of a live audience. The content on his YouTube channel has been viewed over a half billion times by people all over the world. Now, Josh Johnson is taking his stand-up on the road with Comedy Band Camp , a unique live experience that combines comedy and music with the community of a band and the fun of summer camp.

events.title: Queens of the Stage Age
events.summary: Queens of the Stone Age will support their soon-to-be-released album Perfecth on a 2027 tour. They will be joined by Pixies at TD Garden.
events.description: Queens of the Stone Age will support their soon-to-be-released album Perfecth on a 2027 tour. They will be joined by Pixies at TD Garden. Tickets go on sale October 29 at 10 AM on Ticketmaster.com Produced by Homme and band member Michael Shuman, Perfecth was made in the spirit of Kintsugi — the Japanese art of repairing broken pottery by filling its cracks with gold, which holds that what has been shattered is made more beautiful, not less, by the act of repair. It’s an album that could only have been made right now thanks to band members taking significant evolutionary steps as a collective and arriving at hard-won clarity, its nine songs map different forms of love: of family, friends, and others both significant and insignificant. The loves that break you beyond survival and the loves that put you back together. Birthed from sessions tracked everywhere from New Orleans to Los Angeles, the music is fearless and boundless, moody and menacing, gentle and strange. Here, Queens have moved a career's worth of jagged pieces into alignment. "Every song sounds like it's from a different world," says Homme. "And that's on purpose, because it's trying to stitch together all these emotions revolving around love, lust, foolishness, and the sort of wisdom that comes as a gift from all that." The newly announced dates will follow previously announced stops in Iceland, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Hong Kong, Singapore and at Lollapalooza’s three Latin American editions.

events.title: Bianca Del Rio: It Gets Bitter - World Comedy Tour
events.summary: Get ready to swallow a jagged pill of truth because the "Clown in a Gown" is back and meaner than ever. Bianca Del Rio returns to the global stage with her seventh solo stand-up tour, "It Gets Bitter" .
events.description: Get ready to swallow a jagged pill of truth because the "Clown in a Gown" is back and meaner than ever. Bianca Del Rio returns to the global stage with her seventh solo stand-up tour, "It Gets Bitter" . This milestone trek isn't just another night of comedy; it’s a celebration of 30 years of professional drag excellence and three decades of Bianca absolutely hating everything you stand for. Expect a masterclass in vitriol as the RuPaul’s Drag Race winner turns her razor-sharp tongue toward the absolute absurdity of modern life. From the vapid landscape of pop culture to the chaotic state of world events, and—most importantly—the mundane things people do every day that drive her to the brink, no topic is off-limits and no ego is too big to be deflated. A Stern Warning: If you are sensitive, easily offended, or possess a fragile sense of self-worth, do not select seats near the stage. In classic Bianca fashion, the front row is a firing squad, and no one is safe from her legendary biting insults and lightning-fast wit. She’s seasoned, she’s legendary, and she’s officially exhausted by your nonsense. The old saying is "It gets better", but Bianca is proof that after 30 years in tights "It Gets Bitter"!

events.title: Heathers The Musical
events.summary: Following smash hit runs in London and New York, the WhatsOnStage "Best New Musical" winner is coming to the Shubert Theatre!
events.description: Following smash hit runs in London and New York, the WhatsOnStage "Best New Musical" winner is coming to the Shubert Theatre! Welcome to Westerberg High, where popularity is a matter of life and death, and Veronica Sawyer is just another of the nobodies dreaming of a better day. But when she’s unexpectedly taken under the wings of the three beautiful and impossibly cruel Heathers, her dreams of popularity finally start to come true. That is, until J.D., the mysterious teen rebel, teaches her that it might kill to be a nobody, but it’s murder being a somebody… Praised as “an outrageous, irrepressible musical” ( The New York Times ) and “Mischievous fun” ( New York Sun ), Heathers The Musical has broken box office records worldwide. Based on the hit film by Daniel Waters, Heathers The Musical features book, music and lyrics by Kevin Murphy and Laurence O’Keefe.

events.title: Colum Tyrrell
events.summary: Colum Tyrrell brings his stand-up comedy to Comedy Connection in East Providence, Rhode Island, on June 4–5. Join us for live comedy with the Irish comedian and podcast host, whose credits span New York comedy clubs, television and some of…
events.description: Colum Tyrrell brings his stand-up comedy to Comedy Connection in East Providence, Rhode Island, on June 4–5. Join us for live comedy with the Irish comedian and podcast host, whose credits span New York comedy clubs, television and some of comedy’s best-known podcasts. After beginning his comedy career in Ireland, Tyrrell moved to New York City, where he established himself in the stand-up scene. He has performed regularly at the Comedy Cellar, The Stand Comedy Club and Stand Up New York, and has appeared on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon. Comedy podcast fans may recognize Tyrrell from his appearances on Legion of Skanks, You Know What Dude, Are You Garbage? and Matt and Shane’s Secret Podcast. He launched The Colum Tyrrell Podcast in 2022, and his current podcast projects include Cockfight and Collie’s 10 Minute Pod. Whether you discovered him through his podcast appearances, caught his late-night television set or are seeing him for the first time, catch Colum Tyrrell live at Comedy Connection on June 4–5. Located at 39 Warren Avenue in East Providence, the club welcomes comedy fans from across Rhode Island and the Providence area. Get your tickets directly through Comedy Connection. Tickets: https://www.ricomedyconnection.com/events/colum-tyrrell-2027

events.title: Chamber Series Finale: Violinist Njioma Grevious
events.summary: Closing the Chamber Series season, violinist Njioma Chinyere Grevious brings her “superb” (Chicago Classical Review) artistry to the Recital Hall for a program featuring Bach, Brahms, Mozart, and more.
events.description: Closing the Chamber Series season, violinist Njioma Chinyere Grevious brings her “superb” (Chicago Classical Review) artistry to the Recital Hall for a program featuring Bach, Brahms, Mozart, and more. A Juilliard graduate and founding member of the Abeo Quartet, Grevious appears regularly as a soloist and chamber musician at major venues including Carnegie Hall, Wigmore Hall, and the Concertgebouw, and performs with orchestras such as the Chicago Philharmonic and Sphinx Virtuosi.

events.description: For the close of Season 30 we’re throwing a party in Roger Williams Park Temple to Music! Violinist Johnny Gandelsman and composer Gonzalo Grau return to reprise the salsa-inspired violin concerto CMW commissioned in 2013, alongside the premieres of two new works by Grau. Joined by CMW musicians, students, and a salsa band, the finale will spill beyond the stage with dancing, food, a parade, and festivities worthy of 30 remarkable years. Carnivale: The Season 30 Celebration Sunday, June 6 Temple to Music, Roger Williams Park This concert is free, but you can support CMW with a ticket price of your choosing. ***Reserve your seat below***

events.title: Jimmy Carr: Killing Jokes
events.summary: In comedy, 'killing' is a good thing. Everywhere else, it's frowned upon. Jimmy has confirmed kills in over 50 countries and on 13 specials. Eyewitnesses describe it as 'a brutal, hilarious, life affirming night out’.
events.description: In comedy, 'killing' is a good thing. Everywhere else, it's frowned upon. Jimmy has confirmed kills in over 50 countries and on 13 specials. Eyewitnesses describe it as 'a brutal, hilarious, life affirming night out’. The brand-new show Killing Jokes is packed with fast, dark one-liners about all kinds of terrible things. But they are just jokes. They're not the terrible things. Jokes are like magnets. They attract some people and repel others. You can joke about anything, but not with anyone. If you’re attracted to Jimmy's brand of comedy and think you can take the jokes, then by all means come out and play. If you think you'd be offended, then stay away. At this point, being offended at a Jimmy Carr show is like buying a ticket to a horror movie and complaining you got scared. Don’t be a dummy. Look, if you’ve read this far, we know you want to come. So hurry up and buy a ticket. It’ll sell out, so don’t miss out.
